_comment: Stage A parameters. Shaped like the worker input contract (plan.md 4.2) so controller/rollout.py can splice this straight into GG_INPUT alongside the policy weights.
_tuning_note: Measured, not guessed. plan.md 3.3 suggests lr 3e-4 and beta 0.01->0.001 for a 25-40 generation demo; at Stage A that leaves the policy near-uniform (entropy stays at log(9)=2.197) because the final layer starts at 0.01 scale and 30 Adam steps of 3e-4 cannot grow it. lr 8e-3 with linear decay to 10% learns inside ~100 generations. beta_end is dropped to 1e-4 because a 1e-3 floor holds entropy near 1.5-1.9 and the sampled and argmax policies then disagree completely - one run reached 100% greedy success with 0% sampled, another the reverse. Driving beta lower lets the policy commit so the two agree. value_coef turns on the fitted V(o) baseline that plan.md 3.2 step 5 offers 'if variance is high': at Stage A every sandbox flies the same universe, so returns vary far more along t than across the batch and a batch-mean baseline leaves the advantage encoding little but elapsed time. lr_final_frac is 1.0 (NO decay): decaying to 10% was tried and starved the run - at generation 80 of 200 the effective lr was ~5e-3 and entropy had moved only 2.20->1.95 with zero captures, where the constant-lr config was already succeeding. At this generation budget the run ends before decay can pay for itself.
